name: data-analysis
description: Analyse a CSV file in this chat: column statistics and bar, line, scatter or histogram charts saved as PNG.

tools.name: describe_csv
tools.description: Row count and per-column statistics (numbers: count, missing, mean, median, std, min, max, sum; text: unique values and the most frequent ones) for a CSV file in this chat's folder.

path.description: CSV file in this chat's folder, e.g. data.csv

tools.name: chart_csv
tools.description: Draw a chart from CSV columns and save it as a PNG file card. Bar charts total (or average) y per x category.

path.description: CSV file in this chat's folder

x.description: Column for categories or the x axis (the value column for hist)

y.description: Numeric column for bar, line and scatter charts

aggregate.description: How bar charts combine rows, default sum
